name: Bauernhof Kleinwolfingerhof
beschreibung: The farm Bauernhof Kleinwolfingerhof is located in Ebbs in the Tyrolean Unterland. Operated as an authentic inn featuring savory regional cuisine, it also offers welcoming holiday apartments. The rooms are comfortably furnished and equipped with modern amenities. Guests can savor homemade agricultural specialties fresh from the farm. The surrounding area invites outdoor enthusiasts to scenic hikes and bike tours in the Kaiser Mountains. The nearby River Inn provides great water sport opportunities. The farm serves as an ideal base for trips to historic Kufstein and neighboring Bavaria, marked by warm family hospitality.
